'''Rescue Our Lesser Brothers''' was an organization dedicated to the protection of the endangered [[Species/Legends|species]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ac" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Rescue Our Lesser Brothers decided to help the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] species on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] from the violent [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]]. The organization determined that reducing the number of the Dulok population could be beneficial for the Ewoks. A representative was then sent to Endor in order to recruit people willing to attack the [[Korga Cave]]. Beyond Ewoks, Rescue Our Lesser Brothers also helped the [[Narglatch/Legends|Narglatches]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Kimogila]]s on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG:ac" />
